about_the_game:
It's your first day at college after being home-schooled for your entire life, essentially. You have two best friends you've known since childhood, but you should come out of your shell and meet new people. But it's challenging to do that when everyone seems to carry some baggage behind them, and some of them take it out on you. And then it gets worse. Much. Much. Worse.

But maybe. 

Just maybe. You can make it easier for someone out there in the world. If only you knew what's going on...

By Your Hands is an erotic gay furry murder-mystery visual novel created by ChellayTiger and written by Nemo. This is a story that explores trauma, personal baggage, and the process of rebuilding relationships after loss. This is not for the faint of heart and can be emotionally taxing for more sensitive audiences. Pick your choices carefully to maintain the relationships you're growing and solve the mystery that causes the entire school to quake in their boots. It won't be easy, but it's the only way to make the ones you love be happy.

Pick from Five Different Routes

There are five different guys to romance with, each one with their own path and story. See what secrets they're holding.

Choose What Kinks To Indulge In

There are many different kinks you can enjoy. Either be as degenerate as possible or refrain from any perversion by turning on SFW mode in the settings.

Visit The CG Gallery

Wanted to look at a certain visual again? You can experience all the CGs and music tracks you've unlocked in the CG Gallery.

Completely Custom-Made Soundtrack

Listen to music from various genres that immerses you into the wild and chaotic world these characters live in. You can listen to the entire soundtrack in the game's Music Room. 

Credits and Attributions

Major code assistance done by Shie. GUI done by Hijiri. Soundtrack composed by Brkn Hvn. Additional songs by Haoran. Editing for "Blood Sucking" done by HugeCookie. Code for Inline Coding, Music Room, and Masked Layered Images goes to Feniks. Background images from Pexels, Pixabay, and iStock images.

content_descriptors.notes: This VN includes sexually explicit content of a homosexual male nature. It shows or discusses racism, murder, violence, mental illness, sexual harassment, drug abuse, homophobia, and strong language. It's also planned to show or discuss themes of manipulation, toxic relationships, suicide, unglorified sexual assault, child abuse, and self-harm. This game is intended for audiences 18 or older. Please do not play this VN if you aren't at least 18.

short_description: A murder mystery visual novel where you play a fish-out-of-water college student who must face the best and worst traits animalkind has to offer. Solve the mystery of this school as you develop close bonds, get intimate, and uncover shocking secrets with alluring, yet deeply flawed, ordinary men.
